_comment: organisations-role-mapping-and-access-review. The access review lives on the contact person: Keep access writes when it was confirmed and by whom through OpenRegister, so the audit trail records the decision. Only the access review endpoint writes them (after its own reviewer check); through the plain object API only an admin may set them, so nobody can mark their own access as reviewed. A person is due for review when accessReviewedAt is empty or older than the interval in the admin role mapping. Role-group sync and the access review find a person's account by username. Only the contact person sync writes it (as a system save, once the account exists); through the plain object API only an admin may set it, because whoever sets a username on a contact person that holds roles puts that account into the role groups (decision 25 Nov 2026).

accessReviewedAt.title: Access reviewed at
accessReviewedAt.description: When a functional administrator or Nextcloud admin last confirmed or changed this person's access.

accessReviewedBy.title: Access reviewed by
accessReviewedBy.description: The user id of the reviewer who last confirmed or changed this person's access.

username.title: Username
username.description: The Nextcloud account this contact person signs in with. Set by the contact person sync when it creates or finds the account.
